summary: Ermenegildo Zegna N.V. furnished a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing the date for its first half 2026 financial results release and conference call. No special-situation event is reported; the filing is a routine earnings calendar notice. The registrant is the issuer providing ordinary disclosure. No deal terms, advisors, or strategic actions are involved. This is not an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or other corporate event. The filing serves only to inform investors of the upcoming results date and call logistics, with no impact on capital structure or ownership.
